notes:
Both assigned blind entries supply identical references, study identifiers, descriptions, requested metric and p.7 locators. No predictor/outcome distinguishes them. Do not assign beta rows using audit ID or input order. Replication acquired from the authors’ OSF Stage 2 manuscript (https://osf.io/download/yr64w/); title and author list verified. Replication Table 4 prints beta weights and confidence intervals for four separate predictors, without per-coefficient p values. The original-sample reanalysis in this replication paper is a different analysis and was not substituted for the original published result. Reported success records the authors’ paper-wide narrative only; effect-specific success remains unverified.
